name: Euclidean Distance
description: You are given a multiset of points on the plane with integer coordinates. Find the maximum distance between two points from this multiset.
input_specification: The first line of input contains the number of points n ( 2 ≤ n ≤ 50 ). Next, n pairs of lines follow, each describing a single point: the first line contains x -coordinate, the second one — the y -coordinate ( - 50 ≤ x , y ≤ 50 ). Some of the points can have identical coordinates.
output_specification: Output the maximum distance between two points from this multiset. The answer is considered to be correct if its absolute or relative error does not exceed 10 - 4 .
approach_summary: Identify exchange argument or greedy choice property. Sort elements by payoff ratio or deadline and greedily pick candidates to achieve global optimum.
